data.narrative:
Cognition is a Series C–stage AI & Software company founded by Scott Wu, Steven Hao, and Walden Yan, having raised $1.5B+ to date. The relevant peer universe comprises 4 same-sector, same-stage private comparables (Figure AI, Skild AI, Crusoe Energy, Together AI) valued between $8.3B and $39.0B, alongside 1 public comparable (Palantir).

Two valuation methods are applicable. The stage-progression method, anchoring to the $1.0B total-raised proxy and applying a typical 1.7x Series C step-up multiplier, implies $1.7B. The peer-median method, based on the median valuation of the 4 same-stage AI & Software comparables, implies $12.0B. The peer set exhibits material dispersion, with Figure AI at the high end ($39.0B) and Together AI at the low end ($8.3B), reflecting differentiation in perceived technology maturity or market opportunity.

Triangulating these two methods produces a range of $1.4B (low) to $13.8B (high), with a median of $6.8B. The wide spread reflects tension between Cognition's capital-raise trajectory relative to near-peer valuations. Key uncertainties include revenue run rate and growth trajectory, which are not disclosed, as well as the relevance of the peer set, particularly Figure AI's substantial valuation premium relative to the cohort median. A valuation toward the lower-to-middle portion of the range may be more defensible absent material evidence of outsized revenue or a differentiated product moat.
